sloka: राज्यश्रीः न जहाति त्वाम् गत असुम् अपि मानद ।सूर्यस्य आवर्तमानस्य शैल राजम् इव प्रभा ॥४-२३-२९॥
transliteration: rājyaśrīḥ na jahāti tvām gata asum api mānada ।sūryasya āvartamānasya śaila rājam iva prabhā ॥4-23-29॥

translations.english: 'O venerable one, even though life has departed from you, kingly glory does not leave you any more than the light of the setting son leaves the king of mountains. (western mountain)
